description:
The process of Vacations Request starts when any employee of the organization submits a vacation request.
Once the requirement is registered, the request is received by the immediate supervisor of the employee requesting the vacation.
The supervisor must approve or reject the request.
If the request is rejected, the application is returned to the applicant / employee who can review the rejection reasons.
If the request is approved a notification is generated to the Human Resources Representative, who must complete the respective management procedures.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_VacationRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacations Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_VacationRequest">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Submit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RegisterRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewRejection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supervisor" name="Immediate Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApproveOrReject</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Decision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_NotifyHR</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="Human Resources Representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteManagement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Submit" name="Vacation request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApproveOrReject" name="Approve or reject vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Request approved?" default="Flow_Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewRejection" name="Review rejection reasons">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Vacation request rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyHR" name="Notify Human Resources Representative">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteManagement" name="Complete vacation management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Vacation request approved and processed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Submit" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_ApproveOrReject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ApproveOrReject" targetRef="Gateway_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyHR">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyHR" targetRef="Task_CompleteManagement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CompleteManagement" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
